title: CELINE MappingSpec
description: Schema for CELINE declarative mapping spec YAML files.

version.description: Spec FORMAT version, which selects the template dialect for id_template, iri_template, label_template and templated constants. '1' is str.format_map with single-brace {var}. '2' is Jinja, rendered in a sandbox with StrictUndefined so a template naming a variable the row does not carry fails instead of silently rendering an empty string into an IRI. Unrelated to `profile.version`, which is the ontology version. Selected here rather than sniffed from the template text so a literal brace never changes what a file means.

profile.description: The ontology profile whose SHACL shapes can validate this mapping's output. Absent means the newest packaged CELINE profile, resolved at validation time — legal, but a weaker statement than a pin: the shapes that ran are then whatever the deployed library happened to carry.

name.description: Profile name, e.g. 'celine'. Not every mapping targets CELINE — a spec may map purely onto SOSA, SAREF or CIM terms.

version.description: Version pin, e.g. 'v0.10'. Pinning is what stops a newer ontology release from retroactively deciding a dataset stopped conforming; the shipped window of versions is what makes an old pin still resolvable.

target_type.description: RDF class CURIE or full IRI (e.g. 'peco:Renewable_energy_community')

id_template.description: Template for @id. Dialect follows `version`: {var} under '1', {{ var }} under '2'. Variables: row fields + context dict. A relative result has the caller's base_uri applied, which is how a deployment decides where its entities live; an absolute result is left alone.

label_template.description: Optional template for rdfs:label shorthand. Dialect follows `version`.

context_vars.description: Names of variables injected from the caller context (not from the row).

source.description: Key in the input row dict. Omit for kind=constant.

target.description: Ontology property CURIE or full IRI.

datatype.description: XSD datatype CURIE (e.g. xsd:string, xsd:decimal). Used for kind=literal.

required.description: Raise MappingError if source field is absent or null.

iri_template.description: Template for kind=iri. Dialect follows `version`; the source field value is available as `value`. A relative result has base_uri applied, same as id_template — object references and subjects must land in the same namespace.

nested_type.description: RDF class CURIE for the nested sub-node. Required for kind=nested.

nested_fields.description: Field mappings applied to each item in the nested list/object.
